html_title: StreetZim — Ol map ofline blong Kiwix
meta_description: Ol fri map blong OpenStreetMap we oli wok ofline insaed long Kiwix. Vekta tael, pija blong satelaet, graon 3D mo save blong Wikipedia — i wok taem i no gat intanet long iOS, Android, Mac, Windows mo Linux.
tagline: Ol map blong OpenStreetMap we oli wok ofline insaed long Kiwix. Vekta tael, pija blong satelaet, graon 3D mo Wikipedia — yu no nidim intanet.
maps_intro: Jusum wan rijen daon ya, putum Kiwix long tul blong yu, mo openem .zim fael. Ol fael oli stap long Internet Archive — evri daonlod i gat torrent tu.
maps_intro_lang: Jusum wan rijen daon ya mo daonlodem long Bislama: ol nem long map, lukaot mo Wikipedia oli stap long Bislama. Openem fael long Kiwix, hemia wan fri app; pej blong wanwan map i soem olsem wanem blong mekem, step afta step.
feature_key_intro: Ol mak long wanwan kad oli soem wanem i stap insaed:
badge_overture_desc: ol websaet, fon namba mo sosol midia blong Overture,
badge_photo_desc: faenem wan ples long foto blong wan saen.
filter_aria: Lukaot insaed long lis blong ol map
what_lead: StreetZim i putum data blong OpenStreetMap — ol kantri o ol fulwan kontinen — insaed long wan ZIM fael nomo, mo yu save openem long Kiwix. Hem i wok ofline fulwan: i no gat seva, i no gat API, mo yu no nidim intanet afta long fas daonlod.
what_p2: Plante ofline map app oli yusum raster tael; StreetZim i yusum vekta tael we tul blong yu nomo i droem wetem MapLibre GL JS. Taswe map i ron isi taem yu muvum, mekem i bigwan mo tanem, mo i gat graon 3D tu — evri samting i kam long wan fael nomo long tul blong yu.
feat_vector_p: Ol map we oli klia mo oli ron isi kasem ol rod, wetem OpenMapTiles skima, mo MapLibre i droem long semtaem.
feat_sat_p: Ol pija blong Sentinel-2 we i no gat klaod, 10 mita long wanwan piksel, blong fulwan eria blong map.
feat_terrain_p: Sado blong hil mo haet blong graon long 3D, i kam long Copernicus GLO-30 DEM blong fulwan wol.
feat_wiki_p: Presem wan siti, hil o wan ples we plante man i save, blong luk atikol blong hem long Wikipedia wetem ol bigfala save.
feat_search_p: Lukaot insaed long plante milian nem blong ol ples, rod, pak, hed blong hil, epot mo ol narafala ples.
feat_offline_p: Wan .zim fael nomo. I no gat akaon, i no gat man i folem yu, i no gat intanet. Openem mo go.
step1_p: Wan fri app blong iOS, Android, Mac, Windows mo Linux. Tekem long kiwix.org. Long Windows mo Linux, openem ol map long Kiwix PWA naoia: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 i soem ol map we oli emti, mo fasin blong stretem i stap yet long ol nightly build nomo.
step2_p: Jusum wan rijen antap mo daonlodem .zim fael (o tekem torrent sipos yu wantem i go kwik moa).
step2_p_lang: Jusum wan rijen antap mo presem baten blong daonlod: yu kasem map long Bislama, long wan .zim fael.
step3_p: Openem .zim fael long Kiwix. Hemia nomo — map i wok ofline fulwan.
sources_h2: Ol sos blong data mo ol laesens
sources_intro: StreetZim i wokem evri samting long open data nomo. Wanwan ZIM map i gat ol samting we oli kam long ol sos ya:
src_map: Data blong map: © Ol man we oli wok wetem OpenStreetMap, i stap andanit long Open Database License (ODbL).
src_sat: Pija blong satelaet: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, blong yusum we i no blong bisnis nomo.
src_elev: Haet blong graon: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, oli givim andanit long COPERNICUS blong Yuropian Yunion mo ESA.
src_place: Save long ol ples: Wikidata (CC0) mo Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: StreetZim i yusum ol Kiwix app blong openem ol .zim fael. Evriwan oli open source mo oli wokem long GitHub:
footer: StreetZim hem i wan open source projek. Sos kod i stap long GitHub. Ol map oli stap long Internet Archive.
tier_continent: Ol kontinen mo ol bigfala eria olsem
tier_multi_country: Ol rijen we i gat plante kantri

card_languages_title: Map ya wetem ol nem mo Wikipedia long narafala lanwis, brausa blong yu i joenem

card_no_lang: I no stap yet long Bislama: map ya i gat ol nem blong ples long lanwis blong ples, mo ol baten oli stap long Inglis.
mp_meta_description: Fri ofline map blong {name} blong Kiwix app: ol rod, ol ples, lukaot, rod blong go mo Wikipedia, long Bislama. I wok taem i no gat intanet long Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows mo Linux.
mp_lead: Wan fri map blong {name} we i wok taem i no gat intanet, insaed long Kiwix app.
mp_feat_search: Lukaot ol rod, adres mo ples.
mp_feat_nav: Rod blong wokbaot, baeskel mo trak, we tul blong yu nomo i wokem.
mp_feat_overture: Ol stoa, restoron mo ol narafala ples wetem websaet mo fon namba blong olgeta.
mp_feat_terrain: Ol hil mo ol bigfala hil long 3D.
mp_feat_satellite: Pija blong satelaet blong fulwan rijen.
mp_feat_wiki: Ol atikol blong Wikipedia long ol siti, ol ples we plante man i save mo ol ples blong visitim.
mp_feat_photo: Lukaot wetem foto: tekem foto blong wan saen blong faenem ples ya long map.
mp_dl_lang_note: Ol nem long map, lukaot mo Wikipedia long Bislama, long wan fael blong Kiwix.
mp_dl_original_note: Map olsem oli wokem: ol nem blong ples oli stap long lanwis blong ples; ol baten mo Wikipedia oli stap long Inglis.
mp_dl_preview: Lukluk map long brausa blong yu
mp_space_note: Bifo yu daonlodem, jekem sipos tul blong yu i gat naf spes. Ol bigfala map i gud blong daonlodem long Wi-Fi.
mp_updated: Data blong map i kam long {date}.
mp_other_langs_h2: Map ya long ol narafala lanwis
kg_h2: Olsem wanem blong openem map long Kiwix
kg_android_1: Putum Kiwix long Google Play. Hem i fri.
kg_android_2: Daonlodem map antap. Fon blong yu i putum long Downloads.
kg_android_3: Openem Kiwix, go long laebri blong hem mo ademap fael we yu daonlodem finis.
kg_ios_1: Putum Kiwix long App Store. Hem i fri.
kg_ios_2: Daonlodem map antap. Safari i putum long Files app, andanit long Downloads.
kg_ios_3: Openem Kiwix, go long laebri blong hem mo openem fael long Downloads.
kg_mac_1: Putum Kiwix long Mac App Store, mo afta openem fael we yu daonlodem finis wetem hem.
kg_pc_1: Openem Kiwix web app long brausa blong yu mo jusum fael we yu daonlodem finis. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 i soem ol map ya we oli emti; fasin blong stretem i stap yet long ol nightly build nomo.
kg_offline: Afta long hemia, map i wok taem i no gat intanet.
hero_h1: Ol map we oli wok taem i no gat intanet
hero_apps: I open long fri app Kiwix:
tour_lead: Evri samting long ol vidio ya i ron long wan fael nomo long tul. Oli rekodem taem intanet i ded; ol smol toktok mo ol dot we oli makem wanwan pres nomo oli ademap afta.
tour_photo_h: Tekem foto blong saen, faenem ples
tour_photo_p: Tekem foto blong wan saen blong rod, fored blong wan stoa o adres long ki kad blong hotel, mo map i lukaot ples we saen i talem. Tul blong yu nomo i ridim ol toktok, long raeting we oli raetem long hem: long ples ya i gat Yukren, Grik, Arabik, Japan, Koria, Jaenis mo Inglis, saed long saed.
tour_photo_note: Long ol map we oli gat mak ya.
tour_zoom_h: Long fulwan siti go kasem wan haos
tour_zoom_p: Ol vekta map oli stap klia long evri zum: flae long fulwan Kyiv go daon kasem wan haos, mo afta lei mo tanem map.
tour_drive_p: Wan rod we i katem Kyiv, fon i wokem mo map i folem long evri tanem. Oli rekodem wetem wan giaman ples blong fon; medel blong rod i ron ten taem kwik moa.
tour_terrain_p: Sado blong hil, graon 3D mo pija blong satelaet: ol bigfala hil antap long Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Semfala lukaot long wanwan raeting, long map blong siti we saen i stanap long hem.
tour_credits: Ol foto blong saen, foto blong get mo ol pija blong satelaet long ol vidio mo pija ya oli wok blong ol narafala man: luk ol nem blong ol man we oli wokem foto mo ol laesens.
gallery_lead: Ol tru skrin blong ol map, long kompiuta mo long fon. Jusum wan blong luk hem bigwan, mo afta go long ol narawan.
gal_city: Wan fulwan siti long wan fael
gal_building: Go daon kasem wanwan haos, long 3D
gal_place: Kad blong ples wetem foto mo sot toktok blong Wikipedia
gal_find: Faenem ol kafe, stoa mo ol narafala samting kolosap
gal_route: Wan rod we fon i wokem
gal_turns: Gaed long evri tanem, olsem wan lis
gal_wiki_layer: Ol atikol blong Wikipedia long map
gal_photo: Lukaot wetem foto i ridim wan saen
langs_lead: Ol nem blong ples, lukaot, gaed long rod, ol atikol blong Wikipedia mo ol menyu blong map hemwan, long lanwis we yu stap ridim. Ol raeting we oli go long lef tu.
langs_step1_p: Jusum long lis daon ya, o long menyu antap long evri pej.
langs_step2_p: Long pej blong lanwis blong yu, bigfala baten long wanwan map i daonlodem map long lanwis ya, long wan .zim fael. Pej ya long Inglis i givim wanwan map olsem oli wokem: ol nem blong ples long lanwis blong ples, ol baten mo Wikipedia long Inglis.
langs_step2_p_lang: Long pej ya, bigfala baten long wanwan map hem i “Daonlodem long Bislama”: map wetem ol nem blong ples, lukaot, Wikipedia mo ol menyu long Bislama, long wan .zim fael. Sipos wan map i no rere yet long Bislama, kad blong hem i talem.
langs_step3_p: Plante map oli save kamaot long ol lanwis we ol man oli toktok long ples ya, olsem Katalan long Spen mo Potugal o Wels long Briten mo Aealan. Ol map long ol narafala lanwis i soem evri lanwis blong evri map mo i joenem fael insaed long brausa blong yu.
langs_demo_note: Semfala map blong Kyiv long Arabik, Hibru, Hindi, Tae, Japan mo Jaenis. Sipos wan nem i no gat translesen, hem i stap olsem oli raetem long ples ya.
langs_grid_note: Namba i soem hamas map oli rere long lanwis ya tedei.
filter_none: I no gat map we i semak long hemia. Traem wan kantri, rijen o siti.
credits_h: Ol foto long ol vidio mo pija blong skrin
credits_intro: Ol vidio mo pija blong skrin oli soem ol map olsem oli stap tru. Ol saen long lukaot wetem foto, wan foto blong wan ples we plante man i save mo ol pija blong satelaet oli wok blong ol narafala man, mo mifala i yusum andanit long ol laesens ya. Mifala i katem ol foto blong saen.
